messages:
Alex K: Following the PM postmortem, we need tight ownership + dates for rollout safety improvements: auto-rollback, flag scoping, recurrence detection.
Maria P: Ill own auto-rollback. Will post a multi-signal policy + short canary plan by Thu EOD.
Jon S: Blast-radius controls (flag scoping + saturation caps) assigned to me, deliverable next Tue. Will include max_users_per_bucket and staged timers.
Irene C: Recurrence detection prototype (grouping by flag+model+error fingerprint). Target: demo in 2 sprints.
Taylor R: Ill write a 1-page oncall checklist for rollback verification (due Mon).
Alex K: Action tracker owner: Alex to create board card and add GitHub handles. ops-bot: schedule a 7-day follow-up reminder.
ops-bot: Reminder set: "Rollout safety sync" in 7 days.
Maria P: Quick config sketch pasted in docs channel; includes 2-signal requirement within 10m window and auto-notify eng-oncall on rollback.
Jon S: Also request infra review for adding global quarantine switch (30s TTL).
Irene C: If same flag+model causes >=3 incidents in 90d, auto-open remediation epic and tag owning team.
Alex K: Prioritize safety over velocity while these land. :+1:
